test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
If + means −, − means ×, × means ÷, and ÷ means +, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

 48 times 4 + 7 - 3 div 14 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9051dd0efbd2df905d65736570ae82170f5d1ce9fe65d7fc7ecf88296fd19d4.png] 

**Given Symbol Meanings:**

+ means −

− means ×

× means ÷

÷ means +

**Given Equation:**

48 × 4 + 7 − 3 ÷ 14
